versions.subject: Create win_susp_psexec.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    EventID: 5145
    ShareName: \\*\IPC$
    RelativeTargetName:
     - '*-stdin'
     - '*-stdout'
     - '*-stderr'
selection2:
    EventID: 5145
    ShareName: \\*\IPC$
    RelativeTargetName: 'PSEXESVC*'
condition: selection1 and not selection2
versions.spl: EventID=5145 ShareName="\\*\\IPC$" RelativeTargetName IN ("*-stdin", "*-stdout", "*-stderr") NOT (EventID=5145 ShareName="\\*\\IPC$" RelativeTargetName="PSEXESVC*")
